metadata.long_url_policy: First 384 and last 128 canonical Unicode code points

cascade_policy.routing_policy: Inclusive RF uncertainty interval; convex blend inside gate, unchanged RF outside. Gate/weight selected only on selection set.

fresh_holdout_manifest.policy: Frozen before neural training. SHA256 order, one record per unused registrable-domain skeleton; 1000 per class. UCI original label 1=benign inverted explicitly. No predictions used.
fresh_holdout_manifest.limitation: Historical same-source convenience sample, deliberately balanced; not live-web prevalence, external-source or temporal validation.

policy: Weights, vocabulary, epoch and cascade gate frozen before loading either evaluation CSV. No post-test tuning.
promotion_decision: Research candidate only; compare measured errors, source shift and calibration before changing served model.

warm_cpu_latency.includes: Shared parsing, numeric features, RF inference, gate and any routed CNN inference. Excludes SHAP/HTTP. Warm calls only.

stress_caveat: 200 paired offline manipulations per family on historical run06 final. No page visits; synthetic attack intent, not verified malicious deployments. No post-test tuning.
